mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password_hash, display_name, status, role, created_at, updated_at FROM app_user WHERE username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user ( username, password_hash, display_name, status, role ) VALUES ( #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{status}, #{role} )
INSERT INTO auth_session ( user_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_at, last_used_at, revoked_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{lastUsedAt}, #{revokedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT auth_session.id AS session_id, app_user.id AS user_id, app_user.username, app_user.display_name, app_user.role, auth_session.expires_at FROM auth_session INNER JOIN app_user ON app_user.id = auth_session.user_id WHERE auth_session.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND auth_session.revoked_at IS NULL AND auth_session.expires_at > #{now} AND app_user.status = 'ACTIVE'
